column1: # Human-edited source of truth: WHICH language versions we ship and WHAT we build on.
# `make pins` resolves every expanded ref to an immutable digest -> pins.hcl (generated).
# Columns are TAB separated.
#   versions <lang> <v1> <v2> ...     the versions we publish for <lang>
#   <lang>/<role>  <image:tag>        upstream image; "{v}" is replaced by each version
# tomcat is a second axis on top of java: `versions tomcat` lists TOMCAT lines (major.minor);
# tomcat-runtime is published for every (tomcat x java) pair, tagged <tomcat>-java<java>,
# e.g. tomcat-runtime:9.0-java21. The JDK/base pins come from the java/* entries; the Tomcat
# tree itself is copied from the official tomcat image pinned below (so Apache's checksum and
# signature verification stays upstream, and `make pins` moves it weekly with the rest).
# Version policy (checked against endoflife.date, Nov 2026)
#   java    LTS only: 17 (to Oct 2027), 21 (to Dec 2029), 25 (to Sep 2031)
#   node    even/LTS majors: 22 (to Apr 2027), 24 (to Apr 2028), 26 (to Apr 2029). 20 is EOL.
#   go      no LTS; upstream supports the latest two releases: 1.26, 1.27
#   tomcat  9.0 = javax.* (the legacy Java EE 8 / Servlet 4 namespace most existing apps use).
#           Add 10.1 (jakarta.*, needs Java 11+) once an app has been migrated: add it to the
#           `versions tomcat` line, `make pins`, `make test ONLY=tomcat:10.1-java21`.
#   python  no LTS; 5-year security windows. 3.12 (to Oct 2028), 3.13, 3.14.
#           3.11 (Oct 2027) is deliberately left out; 3.15 was just released.
# To add/drop a version: edit its `versions` line, `make pins`, `make test ONLY=<lang>:<v>`.
# Retire a version when its upstream EOL is <6 months away - consumers need time to move.
# OS policy: Debian 13 "trixie" everywhere (distroless *-debian13 and *-trixie images)
# so there is one patching story. (Temurin is only published on Ubuntu; it is used
# solely to jlink the JRE that is copied onto Debian distroless.)
